Verses.137:
You are righteous, LORD,
	and Your judgments are fair.
Verses.138:
You have given Your laws in righteousness
	and great faithfulness.
Verses.139:
My zeal consumes me
	when my enemies forget Your words.
Verses.140:
Your word is very pure,
	and Your servant loves it.
Verses.141:
Though I am lowly and despised,
	I do not forget Your precepts.
Verses.142:
Your righteousness is everlasting,
	and Your law is truth.
Verses.143:
Trouble and anguish have seized me,
	yet Your commandments are my delight.
Verses.144:
Your laws are righteous forever;
	give me understanding so that I may live.
Verses.145:
I called out with all my heart; answer me, LORD!
	I will keep your statues.
Verses.146:
I called out to You, save me
	and I will keep Your statues.
Verses.147:
Before dawn, I rise and cry for help.
	I hope in Your words.
Verses.148:
My eyes anticipate the night watches,
	that I may meditate on Your promise.
Verses.149:
Hear my voice in Your faithfulness.
	Revive me, LORD, according to Your judgments.
Verses.150:
Those who chase after wickedness are drawing near;
	they are far from Your law.
Verses.151:
Yet, You are nearer, LORD,
	and all Your commandments are true.
Verses.152:
Long ago, I learned from Your testimonies.
	I know You established them to endure forever.
